subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: What ACP child tool internals may be shown in parent-visible streams, and under which existing or new verbosity/config controls?
rationale: The request crosses a user-visible security boundary because tool args, results, commands, file paths, and thinking/progress can contain sensitive data, while current main only exposes commentary/status summaries.

options.title: Expose bounded summaries only
options.body: Use sanitized ACP `tool_call` text/title/status summaries through existing progress and tag-visibility controls, without raw result or thinking dumps.

options.title: Add explicit verbose opt-in
options.body: Introduce a separate operator-controlled verbose mode for carefully redacted argument/result snippets if maintainers want deeper debugging visibility.

options.title: Keep raw internals out of parent streams
options.body: Limit the shipped behavior to the already-merged commentary/status progress path and close or narrow requests for raw tool visibility.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded summaries only
recommendation.body: Use sanitized ACP `tool_call` text/title/status summaries through existing progress and tag-visibility controls, without raw result or thinking dumps.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership evidence points to this person on the relay surface, and the unresolved question is a core parent-stream/security boundary decision.
